description: This file defines a Java class `UpdateProvisioningCriteriaRequestCommandHandler` that handles update commands for provisioning criteria within the Fineract system. It implements a command handler interface, is annotated for Spring and custom command processing, and delegates updates to a service layer.

classes.name: UpdateProvisioningCriteriaRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for provisioning criteria, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, and delegating the update logic to the provisioning criteria write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to update provisioning criteria by calling the write platform service's update method with the entity ID and the command.
